description: This file defines a class Attribute within the Opencart Admin Controller Event namespace. It includes methods to hook into attribute editing and deletion events, adding tasks related to product data updates based on attribute changes.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: A controller class that hooks into attribute edit and delete events to trigger tasks for updating related product information.

methods.name: editAttribute
methods.description: Handles post-processing after editing an attribute; schedules tasks to update product info related to the attribute.

methods.name: deleteAttribute
methods.description: Handles post-processing after deleting an attribute; schedules tasks to update product info related to the deleted attribute.
